title: Make swarm cancellation stop running processes and propagate deadlines
goal: P1: CancelBus::propagate merely inserts descendant IDs into terminated; worker registration has only test callers and DAG cancellation is checked between parallel batches. Wire cancellation registration and a shared deadline through native workers, process groups, model calls, peer dispatch and external agents. Retain handles, implement termination/abort, bound waiting and verify exit before reporting terminated. Report irreversible or uncancellable remote work truthfully and suppress late results and subsequent writes. Add nonzero hermetic production-entry tests named swarm_gap_real_cancellation_* cancelling a live shell process, hung model request and peer dispatch mid-batch; assert bounded return, subprocess descendants exited, no post-cancel mutations and accurate unresolved remote status. Do not replace real cancellation with bookkeeping assertions. Preserve existing tests and acceptance records; add regression tests that fail before the repair and execute at least one test. Do not close this task merely because a helper exists or a test filter runs zero tests.
